name: Satou Asami
source:
Asami is the student club president of the Miyanomori High School's chemistry club, of which [url=https://vndb.org/c17365]Takuya[/url] is the only other member. She may be smart, but she's a little bit of an eccentric, often using Takuya as a test subject for her experiments. What role did she play in his [url=https://vndb.org/c34009]most recent trouble[/url]? More importantly, will she be able to help him sort out this new problem?

[Edited from [url=https://www.gamefaqs.com/pc/582010-x-change/faqs/22272]Ben Woodhouse's Walkthrough[/url]]
